notes: 13 of 14 searches used. Search summaries blend pages, so national NHS page attribution was sometimes inferred; the 'testing too soon can miss infection' point rests on local NHS sexual health service pages, and the CDC lines on serious harm without symptoms, condoms/dental dams and douching come from search summaries of CDC pages (US source, labelled as such). The BASHH 2026 PDF was seen only through search summaries (doxycycline first line confirmed); its M. genitalium, test of cure, partner and abstinence sections were not retrieved, so those sentences were removed. Testicular pain as an urgent symptom was not found in retrieved NHS text, so the seekCare urgency route now follows the NHS pelvic inflammatory disease page. Link edits: removed tests:[microbiology-tests] (not connected by sources); affects trimmed (bladder, urinary removed; urethral symptoms not tied to the bladder). Kept symptoms pelvic-pain, abdominal-pain, vaginal-bleeding and medication azithromycin. Whether the page should say 'curable' at all given the site rule on 'cured' is for the reviewer; it is attributed to WHO. Final article block is about 1,216 words.
